instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, left-hand side, C curve, green, red, green, with the red block closer towards you on the bottom half.

assumptions: The 'C' shape implies the green blocks are oriented along the x-axis (horizontal arms) and the red block is oriented along the y-axis (vertical spine).
The green blocks are aligned with each other.
The red block is placed at the left-front corner of the bottom green block to satisfy "left-hand side" and "closer towards you".
evidence: All right, left-hand side, C curve, green, red, green, with the red block closer towards you on the bottom half.
